resources.string: How do I add a movie to my Watchlist?
Open any movie's detail page and tap the Add to Watchlist button. You can view your full watchlist from the Profile tab.
How do I create a Collection?
Go to the Collections tab and tap the + button. Give your collection a name and start adding movies and series to it.
What is TMDB and where does the data come from?
This app uses The Movie Database (TMDB) API to fetch movie and series information, posters, and ratings. TMDB is a community-built movie and TV database.
How do I change the app theme?
Open Profile, tap the gear icon for Settings, then Theme. You can choose Light, Dark, or System default.
What does “Sign in with TMDB” do?

Signing in is optional. It lets the app sync favorites, watchlist, star ratings, and favorite people with your TMDB account. Custom collections, rating notes, recent searches, theme, and notification preferences stay on this device only.
How do I report a bug or request a feature?
Visit the GitHub repository linked in Profile → Settings → About. Open a new issue and describe the bug or feature you would like to see.
